scope: deterministic actual application renders; no physical-device claim
artwork: private local publicly served reference bitmaps and rasterized installed Arial glyphs

advice_capture.basis: Actual certified StrategyTable result; injected only for deterministic capture timing
advice_capture.peek: Solid red borders only while UP is physically held; release has no overlay
advice_capture.autoplay: Triple UP toggles autoplay on and off; each activation starts M. Single/held UP preserves an active mode. During autoplay double UP advances one speed; holding does not. Manual double UP sets exact best holds without drawing. A has no icon Slow, filled left triangle Medium, and adds right triangle Fast. M is first/default, followed by Medium and Fast. M waits at both Deal and Draw: DOWN deals, waits for study, then the next DOWN applies the best holds together and draws immediately. The M mark is 5x4 pixels. No added pacing or animation in M. Other buttons stop autoplay without another action.

manual_autoplay.behavior: DOWN Deal, wait to think; DOWN exact holds and immediate Draw; wait for next Deal

draw_five.appearance: Only the real Draw button face flashes red at one cycle per second, while UP is held after the 0.30-second delay; exact dark label and bevel retained
